notes.title: Eastwynne Demo Launch!
notes.content:
Annndddd the demo's here 🥳🥳

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760750/Eastwynne_Demo"][/dynamiclink]

The MPQ Demo is a short side story/scenario that may or may not be canon to the main Eastwynne game. Consider this a sneak peek of what's to come. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640050/8ba5e70f06a20486bc7dfd5429b5cd3a00a45db0.gif"]


Current Demo Features:


Emphasis on "current", this is part 1 of the demo, and there will be multiple major updates throughout the year. Don't let the beginning style of gameplay fool you...[spoiler]More RPG elements incoming 👀👀[/spoiler]



The "prologue" is completely playable ([spoiler]except for 1 path[/spoiler])

Achievements (Not connected to Steam. I'm sorry y'all, I couldn't get it to work 😩)

[spoiler]Cheat codes[/spoiler]


Game Tips & Guides:


I kinda, intentionally and unintentionally, made the difficulty a bit "questionable"(?) Personally, I'm very quick to run to Google and search for guides, especially with puzzles. And if you're also like me, don't worry, I got you covered👍🏾


MPQ Demo Wiki



This has everything you need in case the difficulty really is questionable and/or you wanna read more about the game's content.


A note on replaying...


You absolutely should, and yes, I'm saying that because I want you to 😘, but also, [spoiler]how else are you gonna unlock more characters to play and learn about 'em?[/spoiler] 



❗❗ Saves may break between game versions.


Future Updates:


This is only part 1, the next major update should be in August/September. I'll be posting previews, updates, and early builds on Patreon/Ko-fi first.

Patreon

Ko-fi


Other Upcoming Updates:


The separate voice audio channel controls will be added soon.

I will add LATAM Spanish & Brazilian Portuguese text translations ASAP.

I'm working on Mac and Linux (maybe?) versions.


Community & Feedback:


Lemme know what y'all think so far, what you like, don't like, want me to add, etc etc by submitting a report, in the reviews and/or the community. I really appreciate y'all playing the demo 💖  

If you'd like to send private feedback and/or bug reports, here's the form: Submit Feedback & Bug Reports


Known Issues:
"The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()" - This happens when the game incorrectly processes videos. It occurs randomly, and the game will crash.

"TypeError: Cannot read property 'width' of null" - This happens when the game incorrectly processes images. It can occur when [spoiler]accessing the character select screens[/spoiler], and the game will crash.


      There's also Discord ↓
